# Spiritual Translation

** ¶2**

Divine Love itself is the Infinite Being from whom all good ness proceeds, and who dwells etern ally in the in most celest ial state where all things are peace and b lessedness. The whole of the Divine nature — Love , Wisdom, and Use as one — stands fully manifest within that state . These two, the Divine Being and Divine Love, are not two re alities but one life : for the Divine * is * Love in its very essence. And because Divine Love gives itself perpetually into every proce eding state of wisdom and into every receiving faculty, flowing without reservation into all that exists from it , therefore the Infinite Being is r ightly known by the name of Love itself . For it is Divine Love that emp owers every recept ive faculty and every successive state of order to prev ail against what opp oses the Divine — gr anting to all that receives it the power of good over evil.

**¶4**

Self -love in its inf ernal form is the first spiritual death, the original turning of the will away from the Divine, which arose out of the proprium. It brought into manifest ation the entire state of the will given over to evil and falsity — the hells themselves . It is known by the name of hatred because it destro ys even the affections and intentions born from itself: evil dev ours its own offspring . More than this , it ass aul ted what is wholly foreign to its nature — the good and the true that belong to the Divine alone — and prof aned them. Therefore it is recognized as the very opposite of Divine order. It has wr ought corruption both in the voluntary life of the natural man and against the spiritual goods that were never its own to possess .

**¶5**

And in the present state of the human race this same self-love continues without ceasing to corrupt every natural aff ection and destroy every impul se of the will. It ext inguishes spiritual life through countless forms of fals ity and evil — every variety of spiritual death that manifests across every faculty and every condition of human existence. Even the interior remains of good and truth — those hidden seeds of wisdom and innoc ence that the Divine has stored within the soul from inf ancy, the living spiritual essence within every person — even these, self -love ass aults and lab ors to destroy, exactly as it has done from the first corruption of the will. Therefore it is called hatred born from hatred , en vy propag ated from envy, the inf ernal from the infernal, evil beg otten from evil: for every form of evil derives he reditarily from prior evil, and the prop rium turned against the Divine reprodu ces itself end lessly after its own kind.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Love is the Father of Greatness, who dwells in his glorious land. The entirety of the divine has been revealed [there]in! These two are a single living body, the Father and his love; because he has given himself for every thing, as he exists in his aeons. Indeed, due to this, they called the Father, the Lord of the totality, 'love'. For he gave the victory to his aeons and his limbs.

Hate is the first death that welled up. It revealed the land of darkness. This one called 'hate', because it has ruined all its perdition's offspring; it sinned even against a power foreign to it, and ruined it. Due to this they shall call it 'hated'; for it has caused destruction, both wounding in flesh, and what is not its own.

Today again it causes wounding and destruction in all flesh. It kills them all with diverse deaths; these that are displayed today in every thing, in every type. Even the Cross of Light, the living soul, likewise too it ruins and kills them; as it did at the start. Indeed, due to this have they called it 'hated', this one from the hated; the envy from the envy; the devil from the devil; the bad that came about from the bad.
